technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value: This EPD is representative for StoSilent Board 100 S, StoSilent Board 105 C and StoSilent Board 110 S. The input data used is based on StoSilent Board 110 S which demonstrates the highest environmental impact of the group due to its mass per m2.  Acoustic panel made of expanded glass granulate for suspended ceiling and wall structures. Area of application: interior, for suspended ceiling and wall structures. The boards, StoSilent Board 100 S and 105 C and 110 S, are manufactured at production sites in Ilmenau and Lauingen. In Ilmenau, all raw materials are getting mixed, formed into shape, dried, tempered, cut and sanded to format, packaged on pallets and forwarded to Lauingen for further processing. At Lauingen, lamination of non-woven fleece on front and rear under pressure, cut to format, application of edge coating and packaging.

technologicalApplicability.value: For suspended ceiling and wall coverings on level surfaces, Rooms with high visual standards, for balanced acoustics and good noise reduction. Application: StoSilent Board 105 C:  adhesive fixed; StoSilent Board 110 S: screw fixed, bonded board joints; StoSilent Board 100 S: screw fixed, bonded board joints. Area of application: Building interiors; In buildings designed for people to reside in; In buildings with the usual interior climatic conditions; Examples: high-quality offices, living spaces, hotel rooms. Properties: up to 200 m² possible without expansion joint (max. side length: 20 m); reduction in the reverberation time; reduction of noise level; improved ability to concentrate; improvement in speech intelligibility; low weight; high degree of stiffness; low moisture-induced and thermal expansion. Format: board edge: sharp-edged/coated; length x width x thickness: 1200 x 625 x 25 mm.
